reviewNotes: Reviewed all 40 cards and every exported speech key against data/pages82-three-piece-2.json vocabulary/furigana and catalog introduction. Corrected duplicated 切り身 and 浮き袋; supplied residual anatomy kanji including 血合い, 中落ち, 胆のう and fin names. Corrected 骨際 to ほねぎわ, 一晩 to ひとばん and 一切れずつ to ひときれずつ. Contextual topic は, directional へ and object を reviewed; preserved lexical はらみ, はいそく, はさき, はいって, はえて and はなして. Loanwords converted to hiragana retaining long vowels. Questions, cloze dialogue, full explanations and extended propositions/actions use Nova generation speed 1.0; vocabulary and very short fragments/groups use 0.85. Display labels and lookup keys unchanged. No listening or audible pitch-accent verification performed.
